title: Smart India Hackathon 2026 (SIH Grand Edition)
description: Smart India Hackathon is a nationwide initiative by AICTE and Ministry of Education to provide students a platform to solve some of the pressing problems we face in our daily lives, and thus inculcate a culture of product innovation and a mindset of problem-solving.
overview: Smart India Hackathon 2026 brings together college students from across India to build software and hardware solutions for problem statements submitted by Central Ministries, State Governments, and Industry Leaders. Winners get cash prizes, incubation support, and government recognition.
eligibility: Regular undergraduate and postgraduate students from recognized Indian colleges
Teams must comprise exactly 6 members with at least 1 female member
Each team must have a faculty mentor assigned by the institute

rounds.title: Internal Campus Hackathon & Nomination
rounds.description: Colleges conduct internal hackathons to select and nominate top 10 team submissions.

rounds.title: National Idea Evaluation Round
rounds.description: Expert evaluation committee reviews submitted PPTs and architecture diagrams.

rounds.title: 36-Hour Non-Stop Grand Finale
rounds.description: Live non-stop coding and prototyping at designated national nodal centers.

rules: Submissions must strictly address one of the official problem statements.
Plagiarism or pre-existing commercial code will result in immediate disqualification.
Code must be pushed to the designated public GitHub repository during the 36-hour window.

title: IIT Bombay Techfest Innovation Challenge 2026
description: Techfest is Asia's Largest Science and Technology Festival organized annually by students of IIT Bombay. The Innovation Challenge invites groundbreaking tech prototypes in Robotics, Sustainability, and DeepTech.
overview: Competitors present working prototypes to a panel of venture capitalists, IIT faculty, and industry leaders. Winning teams receive equity-free seed funding and incubation opportunities at SINE IIT Bombay.
eligibility: Open to B.Tech, M.Tech, Dual Degree, and PhD students nationwide
Working prototype or proof of concept is mandatory for final round

rounds.title: Abstract & Pitch Deck Submission
rounds.description: Submit problem statement, proposed technology stack, and business viability.

rounds.title: Virtual Demonstration & Q&A
rounds.description: Live online working demo with IIT Bombay faculty jury.

rounds.title: Grand Exhibition at IIT Bombay
rounds.description: Physical prototype exhibition and stage pitch during Techfest 2026.

rules: Intellectual Property remains 100% with the participating student team.
Physical demonstration of working hardware or software is mandatory in finale.

title: IIT Madras Shaastra National Hackathon
description: Shaastra is the annual technical festival of IIT Madras. The Shaastra National Hackathon focuses on building AI-driven solutions for Climate Action, Healthcare, and Sustainable Mobility.
overview: Participants get access to cloud infrastructure, GPU credits, and technical mentorship from IIT Madras Pravartak Technologies foundation.
eligibility: Open to all enrolled university students in India
Inter-college and inter-branch teams permitted

rounds.title: Online Aptitude & Code Screening
rounds.description: 60-minute algorithmic contest evaluating Python and Data Structure skills.

rounds.title: 48-Hour Virtual Hackathon
rounds.description: Develop full-stack web/mobile application with Machine Learning models.

rounds.title: On-Campus Final Presentation
rounds.description: Present solution to industry judges at IIT Madras Campus.

prizes.reward: ₹6,00,000 Cash Prize + Direct Interview to IITM Incubation

rules: Teams must submit original source code hosted on GitHub with open-source license.
All API integrations used must be documented in the README.

title: Google Girl Hackathon India 2026
description: Google Girl Hackathon is a program for women engineering students in India. It provides a platform to showcase coding skills, learn from Google engineers, and win internship and full-time hiring opportunities.
overview: Participants solve complex algorithmic challenges and software design problems over multiple rounds, receiving mentorship from Google India software engineers.
eligibility: Female students currently enrolled in B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech/MCA degrees graduating in 2026, 2027, or 2028
Studying at an accredited university in India

rounds.title: Learning & Skill Assessment
rounds.description: Online coding assessment on Data Structures, Algorithms, and System Logic.

rounds.title: Design & Innovation Challenge
rounds.description: Build an impactful solution for accessibility or sustainability using Google Cloud APIs.

rounds.title: Grand Finale & Mentorship
rounds.description: Live presentation to Google Technical Leads and Executive Panel.

rules: Strictly open to female candidates as per program guidelines.
Code evaluation is automated for efficiency and edge-case correctness.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup India 2026
description: Microsoft Imagine Cup is the premier global student technology competition. Dubbed the 'Olympics of Technology', it empowers student developers to create social impact solutions using Microsoft Azure and AI.
overview: The winning team receives $100,000 USD cash prize, 1-on-1 mentorship from Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, and Azure Founders Hub Credits.
eligibility: Students 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university globally
Solutions must utilize Microsoft Azure Cloud Services and AI models

rounds.title: Project Proposal & Video Pitch
rounds.description: Submit a 3-minute video pitch, pitch deck, and Azure architecture diagram.

rounds.title: National Finals India
rounds.description: Live presentation to Microsoft India leadership team.

rounds.title: World Championship
rounds.description: Compete against top global regional winners live on stage.

rules: All projects must deploy core functionality on Azure Cloud.
Teams retain full ownership of their software and patent rights.

title: Amazon HackOn Season 5
description: Amazon HackOn is Amazon India's flagship university engineering challenge. It tests students on customer-centric software design, scalable microservices, and AI-driven supply chain optimization.
overview: Winning teams receive cash awards, Amazon Kindle/Echo goodies, and Pre-Placement Interviews (PPI) for Software Development Engineer (SDE) roles at Amazon India.
eligibility: B.Tech / M.Tech / Dual Degree students in 3rd or 4th year from recognized Indian engineering institutes
Minimum 6.5 CGPA required

rounds.title: Coding & CS Fundamentals Test
rounds.description: Automated online coding assessment on HackerEarth platform.

rounds.title: Prototype Development Phase
rounds.description: 72-hour hackathon building scalable AWS serverless solutions.

rounds.title: Virtual Finale Pitch
rounds.description: Present working demo to Amazon Senior Software Development Managers.

rules: Solutions must adhere to Amazon Leadership Principles.
Code must be modular and pass automated unit test suites.

title: ISRO National Space Robotics Challenge 2026
description: Organized by ISRO's UR Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), this national challenge invites engineering students to design and build autonomous extraterrestrial rover models for lunar and martian surface exploration.
overview: Selected rover prototypes are tested at ISRO's simulated lunar terrain arena in Bengaluru. Winners get direct research internship opportunities with ISRO scientists.
eligibility: Undergraduate and Postgraduate engineering students from Mechatronics, Aerospace, CS, Mechanical, or Electronics branches
Indian citizenship is mandatory for all team members

rounds.title: CAD Design & Simulation Report
rounds.description: Submit 3D CAD models, ROS simulation results, and payload analysis.

rounds.title: Hardware Fabrication Review
rounds.description: Video demonstration of mobility and autonomous obstacle avoidance.

rounds.title: ISRO Lunar Arena Testing
rounds.description: Physical traversal challenge on simulated lunar surface at ISRO Bengaluru.

rules: Rover dimensions and total weight must conform to ISRO microsatellite payload specs.
Communication protocols must operate wirelessly over sub-GHz frequency.

title: DRDO Dare to Dream 4.0 Defence Innovation
description: Dare to Dream is DRDO's flagship contest initiated in memory of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam to promote individual innovators and student startups in Defence and Aerospace technologies.
overview: Areas include Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), Quantum Encryption, Hypersonic Flight Dynamics, and AI-driven Electronic Warfare Systems.
eligibility: Open to individual Indian citizens, university students, and registered Indian startups
No age limit for individual innovators category

rounds.title: Technical Proposal Submission
rounds.description: Submit technical whitepaper outlining novelty, feasibility, and defence applications.

rounds.title: DRDO Scientist Evaluation Panel
rounds.description: Defense scientist panel reviews simulation data and CAD drawings.

rounds.title: National Defence Pitch
rounds.description: Pitch before Scientific Advisor to Raksha Mantri and DRDO Chairman.

prizes.reward: ₹10,00,000 + TDF Prototype Grant up to ₹1 Crore

rules: All submissions are subject to non-disclosure agreements and national security checks.
Innovations must have TRL (Technology Readiness Level) of 3 or above.

title: Flipkart GRID 6.0 Software Development Track
description: Flipkart GRID is Flipkart's flagship Engineering Campus Challenge bringing real-world e-commerce problems in high-throughput distributed systems, conversational AI, and computer vision.
overview: Top performing students get direct interviews for SDE-1 roles (₹32 LPA CTC package) and paid summer internships.
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E / M.Tech / M.E / MS / Dual Degree students graduating in 2026, 2027, or 2028
Open to all engineering branches

rounds.title: E-Commerce Tech Quiz
rounds.description: 30-minute online quiz testing CS fundamentals, System Design, and DBMS.

rounds.title: Proof of Concept Coding Round
rounds.description: Problem submission involving real-time recommendation engines and inventory locking.

rounds.title: National Grand Finale
rounds.description: Live presentation to Flipkart Engineering Leadership.

rules: Teams can consist of students from different branches of the same college.
Strict plagiarism checks enforced using automated code similarity analysis.

title: TCS CodeVita Season 12 (Global Coding Contest)
description: TCS CodeVita holds the Guinness World Record as the World's Largest Computer Programming Competition. It aims to promote competitive programming and connect top coders with TCS global careers.
overview: Coders solve complex algorithmic problems in C++, Java, Python, C#, or Perl across multiple 24-hour rounds. Top coders receive instant career offers at TCS Research and Innovation labs.
eligibility: Undergraduate and Postgraduate students pursuing Science/Engineering degrees with completion year 2026, 2027, or 2028
Open globally to coders of all nationalities

rounds.title: Pre-Qualifier Round (Zone-wise)
rounds.description: 6-hour individual competitive coding round with 6 algorithmic problems.

rounds.title: Qualifier Round
rounds.description: Challenging dynamic programming and graph theory problem set.

rounds.title: World Finale
rounds.description: Top 50 global coders fly to TCS Olympus Campus in Mumbai for 6-hour live contest.

rules: Compilers support C, C++, C#, Java, Python 3, and JavaScript.
Code is evaluated against hidden test cases with strict execution time limits.

title: Infosys HackWithInfy 2026
description: HackWithInfy is Infosys' flagship national competitive coding competition for engineering students in India. It offers cash prizes and direct hiring for Power Programmer and Systems Engineer Specialist roles.
overview: Consisting of 2 online coding rounds followed by a grand 24-hour hackathon finale at Infosys Mysore global education center.
eligibility: BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech students graduating in 2026 or 2027
Aggregate percentage of 60% or CGPA 6.0 throughout academics

rounds.title: Online Coding Assessment Round 1
rounds.description: 3 coding questions of varying difficulty on Infosys Springboard platform.

rounds.title: Online Coding Assessment Round 2
rounds.description: Advanced problem-solving round on Trees, Graphs, and Greedy algorithms.

rounds.title: Grand Finale at Infosys Mysore
rounds.description: Top 100 finalists compete in a 24-hour hackathon for the winner trophy.

rules: Proctored environment with web-cam monitoring enabled during tests.
Multiple submissions allowed within test duration window.

title: Tata Crucible Campus Quiz 2026
location: Online Prelims / Taj Mahal Palace Mumbai
description: Tata Crucible Campus Quiz is India's largest and most prestigious business quiz for college students, hosted by renowned quizmaster Giri Balasubramaniam (Pickbrain).
overview: Testing knowledge across corporate history, technology trends, business acquisitions, brand logos, and economic history.
eligibility: B-School, Engineering, Undergraduate, and Postgraduate students from any university in India
Both team members must be from the same institution

rounds.title: Online Preliminary Quiz
rounds.description: Fastest-finger-first 20-question business knowledge test.

rounds.title: Zonal Cluster Finals
rounds.description: Buzzer-based online cluster finals across 12 Indian zones.

rounds.title: National Grand Finale Mumbai
rounds.description: Live stage grand finale hosted at Taj Hotel Mumbai.

rules: Negative marking applicable on incorrect buzzer responses in finals.
TATA Group employees' children are eligible provided they are regular students.

title: EY Techathon 5.0 Generative AI Challenge
description: EY Techathon 5.0 invites engineering and business students to build innovative Generative AI solutions for enterprise automation, ESG compliance, and intelligent document processing.
overview: Participants leverage LLMs, RAG pipelines, and cloud services while receiving 1-on-1 mentorship from EY Technology Consulting Partners.
eligibility: Full-time B.E / B.Tech / M.Tech / MBA students graduating in 2026 or 2027
Cross-domain teams encouraged

rounds.title: Executive Summary & Architecture Pitch
rounds.description: Submit GenAI workflow diagram, vector DB choice, and business ROI deck.

rounds.title: Prototype Development & API Integration
rounds.description: Build functional web prototype using LangChain, OpenAI, or Llama 3.

rounds.title: EY Wavespace Finale Presentation
rounds.description: Pitch live demo to EY India Leadership & Executive Jury.

rules: All GenAI API calls must include safety guardrails and hallucination checks.
Source code must be submitted with unit test coverage report.

title: L'Oréal Brandstorm India 2026
description: Brandstorm is L'Oréal's global innovation competition for students. Participants crack tech-driven beauty innovations using AI, AR/VR, and sustainable bio-materials.
overview: The winning team represents India at the International Finals in Paris, France, competing for the 3-month Intrapreneurship Mission at Station F in Paris.
eligibility: Undergraduate and Master's students in India aged 18 to 30
Teams must comprise 3 students

rounds.title: 1-Minute Video & Slide Deck Submission
rounds.description: Pitch innovative BeautyTech concept in 60 seconds.

rounds.title: India National Semi-Finals
rounds.description: Virtual pitch to L'Oréal India Executive Board.

rounds.title: Paris World Finals
rounds.description: Fly to Paris, France to pitch at Station F startup incubator.

prizes.reward: All-expense paid 3-month Intrapreneurship at Station F Paris
Trip to Paris + L'Oréal Management Trainee Offers

rules: Concepts must focus on Tech, Sustainability, or Inclusivity.
English fluency required for global final presentations.

title: Schneider Go Green Student Competition 2026
description: Schneider Go Green seeks bold ideas from students to push the boundaries of green energy management, smart building automation, and circular economy.
overview: Winning student teams get executive mentorship, VIP trips to Schneider Electric Innovation Hubs, and fast-tracked job offers.
eligibility: Students enrolled in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or Energy studies in India
Teams must consist of 2 members with diversity inclusion

rounds.title: Project Synopsis & Deck Upload
rounds.description: Submit problem statement and energy saving calculation matrix.

rounds.title: Regional Mentorship Round
rounds.description: Work with Schneider Electric mentors to refine technical architecture.

rounds.title: Global Pitch Finale
rounds.description: Present live to Schneider Electric Global C-Suite Panel.

rules: Ideas must demonstrate quantifiable carbon reduction metrics.
Proposals must include economic payback analysis.

title: CodeChef SnackDown 2026 Global Championship
description: SnackDown is CodeChef's global team competitive programming contest. Bringing together the world's finest algorithmic programmers to solve complex data structure problems.
overview: Open to all coders worldwide, teams of 2 battle through 4 qualifying rounds to reach the onsite or virtual World Finals.
eligibility: Open to coders of all ages, universities, and professions worldwide
Teams must have exactly 2 members

rounds.title: Qualifier Round 1A / 1B
rounds.description: Solve at least 1 problem out of 5 in 72-hour open round.

rounds.title: Pre-Elimination Round
rounds.description: Top 1500 teams compete in a 2.5-hour intense speed contest.

rounds.title: Elimination Round & Finals
rounds.description: Top 50 global teams battle live for the SnackDown Crown.

rules: Both team members can write and submit code simultaneously.
Strict anti-cheating automated detection active during all timed rounds.

title: MyGov AI for Public Good National Challenge
description: MyGov and Digital India Corporation present the AI for Public Good Challenge to crowd-source AI solutions for Indic language translation, agricultural yield prediction, and citizen service delivery.
overview: Winning solutions get deployed on Bhashini AI platform and Digital India public infrastructure serving 1.4 billion citizens.
eligibility: Open to Indian citizens, researchers, students, and registered tech startups
Solutions must utilize open datasets available on data.gov.in

rounds.title: AI Model Concept & Dataset Submission
rounds.description: Submit GitHub repository link, model card, and benchmark metrics.

rounds.title: MeitY Cloud Deployment Round
rounds.description: Deploy Containerized API model on NIC Cloud for stress testing.

rounds.title: National Jury Evaluation
rounds.description: Live presentation to Digital India technical architects.

rules: AI models must comply with Responsible AI guidelines and data privacy standards.
Open-source weights (MIT or Apache 2.0) receive bonus points.

title: Reliance TUP 8.0 (The Ultimate Pitch)
description: Reliance TUP is one of India's biggest B-Plan and startup pitch competitions hosted by Reliance Industries for B-School and Engineering campuses.
overview: Student entrepreneurs pitch disruptive business ideas across 5 verticals: 5G & Telecom, New Energy, Retail Tech, Media & Entertainment, and Smart Mobility.
eligibility: Full-time B-School (MBA) and B.Tech 3rd/4th year students in India
Teams of 2 to 4 members

rounds.title: Executive Summary & Elevator Video Pitch
rounds.description: Submit a 3-slide deck and 90-second pitch video.

rounds.title: Semi-Final Regional Pitch
rounds.description: Present detailed financial model and Go-to-Market strategy.

rounds.title: Grand Finale at Jio World Centre
rounds.description: Live presentation to Reliance C-Suite Executives and VC Partners.

rules: Financial projections must be realistic with detailed unit economics.
Prototypes must be demonstrated live in final presentation.

title: Accenture Innovation Challenge 2026
description: Accenture Innovation Challenge invites university students across India to innovate solutions under themes: 'Innovate for Business' and 'Innovate for Society' using Cloud, AI, and Quantum Tech.
overview: Top winners earn fast-track interview opportunities for Advanced Application Engineering roles at Accenture India and gadgets.
eligibility: Students from B.E/B.Tech, M.E/M.Tech, MCA, or Dual Degree programs in India
Graduation years 2026, 2027

rounds.title: Idea Submission Round
rounds.description: Submit a 5-slide deck detailing problem definition and tech solution.

rounds.title: Prototype Building & Mentorship
rounds.description: Build functional prototype with guidance from Accenture Innovation Leads.

rounds.title: Grand Finale Pitch
rounds.description: Live presentation to Accenture India MDs and Industry Experts.

rules: Ideas must leverage at least 2 modern technology domains.
Plagiarism checks strictly enforced.

title: Barclays Hack-a-Sol 2026 Fintech Challenge
description: Barclays Hack-a-Sol is a national fintech hackathon challenging students to build resilient banking infrastructure, fraud detection algorithms, and decentralized open banking APIs.
overview: Winning teams earn direct interview entry into Barclays Technology Graduate & Analyst Programs in Pune and Chennai.
eligibility: Engineering students in 3rd or 4th year from recognized Indian universities
Minimum 60% aggregate score

rounds.title: Online Aptitude & Coding Round
rounds.description: 60-minute test on SQL, Data Structures, and Cybersecurity concepts.

rounds.title: 24-Hour Virtual Hackathon
rounds.description: Build working Fintech application using REST APIs and secure authentication.

rounds.title: Barclays Jury Finale
rounds.description: Present prototype to Barclays VP of Technology.

rules: All API endpoints must include JWT or OAuth2 authentication security.
Database schema must follow 3NF normalization rules.
